description: The map starts at longitude 362.5, so the z5 tile has wrap 1. Jumping to longitude 2.5 is a wrap jump: every tile is renumbered to wrap 0 without moving it on screen, so when zooming in from 5 to 6 the label is handed over from the z5 tile to its z6 child, both now of wrap 0. State is shared only between tiles of the same wrap. The label is offset left at z5 and right at z6 so that its two copies don't overlap. Fades last 100 ms: the jump happens at 60 ms and the clock is frozen at 80 ms, so the label continues its fade and is drawn once at 0.8 opacity. If the handover didn't follow the renumbering, the z6 tile wouldn't find its parent: the new copy would start fading in from 0 and be drawn at 0.2, beside the old copy fading out at 0.4.
